title: Data of the event digest.text_dropped
description: The model paragraph of a digest or summary was not sent because it holds a number: a token with a digit that is not an allowed name, date or time, or a number word (REP-4). numbers_checked counts the tokens with digits and the number words read, numbers_unmatched the rejected ones. Only counts and ids; no text and no numbers of the paragraph (AUD-2).
